message:
docs(policy): --input-injection-mode none counts as an explicit OFF

parse_input_injection_mode treats none as Disabled, so it is a supported value and not an
unknown fallback. It counts as explicit OFF when the exact argv, the fixed source/binary and
that launch's effective OFF are all checked. The 'unsupported mode' startup wording is what
caused the confusion. Passing --config clears the inherited encoded-experiment env, so it is
the alternative only when a full runtime profile is wanted.
Reviewed by Codex (codex_test_injection_finding.md, mode conflict).
